projects.name: trimly
projects.description: Open-source tool (TypeScript/Node CLI) to track token consumption for Claude Code. @trimly/core & @trimly/cli published on npm under the Apache-2.0 license.

problemsSolved.problem: It is hard to track and control token consumption — and therefore costs — when using Claude Code daily.
problemsSolved.solution: Open-source CLI that measures, aggregates and displays token consumption in real time, with a reusable API (@trimly/core) and a command-line interface (@trimly/cli).
problemsSolved.impact: Immediate visibility on costs, adoption by the open-source community, published on npm under Apache-2.0.

projects.name: Forenlyst
projects.description: Deepfake detection and forensic certification SaaS: Next.js front-end, NestJS back-end with Python microservices and cryptographic signing.

problemsSolved.problem: The rise of deepfakes makes it hard to verify the authenticity of visual content.
problemsSolved.solution: A deepfake detection platform paired with forensic certification and cryptographic signing of the results.
problemsSolved.impact: Reliable media authentication and traceability of analyses for professional and legal use cases.

projects.name: Portfolio — Mikaël Wawrziczny
projects.description: Personal portfolio built with Nuxt 3, fully typed with TypeScript, featuring advanced SEO, i18n, automatic dark mode, animations, an integrated AI assistant and a custom design system.

problemsSolved.problem: Senior freelancers often struggle to showcase a modern, fast, multilingual portfolio that truly reflects their skill level.
problemsSolved.solution: Creation of a highly optimized Nuxt 3 portfolio: hybrid SSR/CSR rendering, Apple-style design system, integrated AI chat, animated pages, scalable architecture, persistent dark/light mode.
problemsSolved.impact: Exceptional performance, increased recruiter conversion, direct demonstration of Nuxt 3 / TypeScript / AI expertise.
